svg.title: CherryHQ/cherry-studio: 15% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 15% of 450 recent commits in CherryHQ/cherry-studio carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 450 commits, since 2026-10-14). Claude Code 13%, GitHub Copilot 1.1%, Cursor 0.4%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
